title: Digital Privacy: Your Digital Footprint Does Not Disappear
summary: Every photo, comment, and like leaves a permanent digital footprint. Teach your child: "Before you post, ask: Would I be pleased for my grandfather or my teacher to see this in 10 years?" – Privacy is a right, and protection is a duty.
try_this: Review together the privacy settings of one app your child uses. Enable: private account, no location sharing, and approval before tagging.
reflection_prompts: Which apps did you review the settings for?
Did your child understand the concept of a "digital footprint"?
